sources.title: K3 – A New Problem List in Low-Dimensional Topology
sources.independent_inspection: Complete Problem 5.8 and both remarks, printed page 306. Text and full rendered page inspected. Category, compact-without-boundary hypothesis, dimension, and secondary dimension-four question checked.

sources.title: Aspherical manifolds that cannot be triangulated

sources.title: The Conley index, gauge theory, and triangulations

sources.title: Pin(2)-equivariant Seiberg-Witten Floer homology and the Triangulation Conjecture

sources.title: On the signature of four-manifolds with universal covering spin
sources.independent_inspection: Printed page 757, including an independent rendered-page inspection of the topological spin signature formula. Stable obstruction versus four-dimensional PL structure distinguished.
